text: Yeah thats way better. and even if you could make like one big ahh like oak or pine tree, you could use svg for branches oh and even for driftwood / sticks on the ground. but yeah i like that svg one a lot for that palm tree
resolution: Extended the SVG-path approach the user loved: upgraded PathTube to sweep a proper frame perpendicular to the path tangent (taper by arc index) so ONE geometry handles a vertical trunk, a diagonal branch, and a horizontal stick without pinching. Built cart/wood_probe demoing what that unlocks beyond palms — an OAK whose branches are each a PathTube swept along an SVG branch path (splitting off the trunk, broad-frond leaf clumps at the tips), and DRIFTWOOD/STICKS (the same tube laid flat on the sand). So SVG paths now author trunks, branches, and beach wood from one primitive; pine is the same trunk + downward needle-frond tiers (noted, not yet built). Verified via self-shot. Sha 77cc25443.
